context_sentence: After the long lack finally ended, a quiet sufficiency settled over her.
After the feud, the two sides finally came together and let their grievances go.
When the others fled, he alone held the gate though afraid.
Once the debt was cleared, nothing held him to the old master any longer.
Given two flawed plans, she saw at once which would fail and chose the other.
From childhood a single pull drove her: to reach the far peak.
Each night before the verdict he lay awake, unable to face the days ahead.
He could not set the keepsake down, though it only weighed him further.
The muddle cleared and each step of the argument stood plainly visible.
The wind dropped and nothing in the courtyard moved or stirred.
